messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: starting next quarter we're rolling out a small global PTO harmonization: a 2-day 'Floating Holiday Bank' for every employee, plus a simpler self-serve public-holiday swap flow for folks in regions with differing statutory holidays. Short version: +2 floating days added to balances on April 1, and you can swap local public holidays for other days via the HR portal. Details & FAQs: https://redwood.company/hr/floating-holidays :tada:
Tom (EM): Nice. Are the two days prorated for new hires during their first year?
Maya (People Ops): Yes 1 pro-rated in the first 12 months. New hires joining mid-quarter will see a prorated addition within 48 hours of their start date.
Priya (Sales): Any impact to accruals or payroll?
Rina (Finance): No change to accrual formulas. The floating days are an upfront grant (not additional accrual). They'll be listed as "Floating Holiday" on the payslip for transparency.
Tom (EM): Can managers block-floating days during critical launches or offsites?
Maya (People Ops): Managers can't permanently block them, but teams can set blackout windows for specific dates (e.g., major product launches) up to 6 weeks in advance. The portal will show blocked dates when someone requests a floating day.
Priya (Sales): How does the public-holiday swap work for global teams where teams follow different local holidays?
Maya (People Ops): In the portal choose the public holiday you want to swap out and pick a replacement date within the same calendar year. Swap requests auto-approve unless there's a team blackout or manager flag; managers get notified.
HR Bot: Reminder: floating holiday grant will be applied automatically on 2024-04-01. Check your profile for balance updates.
Tom (EM): Is there an opt-out? Some folks may prefer regular PTO accrual vs floaters.
Maya (People Ops): No opt-out, but managers can suggest converting floating days into accrued PTO only for business-critical exceptions; People Ops approval required. We expect the standard grant will suit most folks.
Priya (Sales): Will contractors get this?
Maya (People Ops): Contractors on Redwood payroll will receive a single-day pro-rated credit at manager discretion; full contractors and contingent workers handled case-by-case. Talk to your People Ops rep.
Rina (Finance): Ops note: we'll include a small line-item in payroll reports for audit. Anyone with special local compliance needs, please loop Legal.
Maya (People Ops): We'll publish a short explainer and a step-by-step video later today. If you spot edge cases, drop them in #people-ops or DM me. Thanks! :seedling:
